stories.title: Norris in pole a Madrid, anche Antonelli in prima fila. Hamilton 4°, Leclerc 5°

en.title: Norris on pole in Madrid, Antonelli also in front row. Hamilton 4th, Leclerc 5th
en.summary: Norris secured pole position at Madrid with the reigning world champion ahead of the championship leader by just 11 thousandths of a second. Antonelli qualified on the front row alongside him.

stories.title: F1. Norris si prende la "pole" a Madrid, Antonelli beffato per 11 millesimi

en.title: F1. Norris takes pole in Madrid, Antonelli beaten by 11 thousandths
en.summary: The McLaren driver delivered a strong performance in Q3 to secure pole position, with Antonelli narrowly missing out. Verstappen qualified third, followed by Hamilton and Leclerc, with Russell sixth.

stories.title: Cremlino, 'Zelensky vuole vedere Putin? Venga lui a Mosca'

en.title: Kremlin: 'If Zelensky wants to see Putin? Let him come to Moscow'
en.summary: The Kremlin stated that an invitation remains open for a meeting to take place in Moscow.

stories.title: Muti: "I governi hanno fatto schifo su Villa Verdi, ora si diano una mossa"

en.title: Muti: 'Governments have done poorly on Villa Verdi, now they must act'
en.summary: The composer Giuseppe Verdi's residence was acquired by the state over a year ago with promises of restoration and public access, though progress has been delayed.

stories.title: Muti: "Villa Verdi è stata abbandonata, governi hanno fatto schifo". Stasera evento col ministro

en.title: Muti: "Villa Verdi has been abandoned, governments have done a terrible job". Event with minister tonight
en.summary: Giuseppe Verdi's residence was acquired by the state eighteen months ago with promises of restoration and public access. Conductor Riccardo Muti criticizes government handling of the property.

stories.title: Gp Spagna: sorpresa Norris in pole, Antonelli beffato per 11 millesimi

en.title: Spain GP: Norris surprise pole position, Antonelli narrowly missed by 11 thousandths
en.summary: McLaren secured pole position at Madrid's inaugural Grand Prix. Ferrari struggled with Hamilton placing fourth and Leclerc fifth.

stories.title: Riccardo Muti: “I governi, sia di destra che di sinistra, hanno fatto schifo su Villa Verdi”

en.title: Riccardo Muti: "Governments, both right and left, have done a terrible job on Villa Verdi"
en.summary: Conductor Riccardo Muti will perform tonight in the garden of composer Giuseppe Verdi's estate, which has long remained abandoned and neglected.

stories.title: Trump: "Sarebbe bella la riunificazione dell'Irlanda". Burnham: "Rispettiamo accordi"

en.title: Trump: "Irish reunification would be nice". Burnham: "We respect agreements"
en.summary: Trump commented on potential Irish reunification while Burnham reaffirmed commitment to the Good Friday Agreement, noting that any border poll would be determined by the Northern Ireland secretary.

stories.title: Burnham a Trump, 'Irlanda unita? Non c'è il sostegno dell'opinione pubblica'

en.title: Burnham to Trump, 'United Ireland? There is no public support'
en.summary: A spokesperson reaffirms that public opinion does not back Irish reunification, responding to statements made by the U.S. president.

stories.title: Villa Verdi dimenticata, la rabbia di Muti: "I governi hanno fatto schifo" Video

en.title: Villa Verdi forgotten, Muti's anger: 'Governments have done poorly'
en.summary: A plea is made regarding the historic residence, now a state property, as concerns about its maintenance are raised.

stories.title: Trump in visita a Dublino: “L’Irlanda tornerà a essere unita: sarà bellissimo”

en.title: Trump visiting Dublin: 'Ireland will become united again: it will be wonderful'
en.summary: The U.S. president's remarks about inevitable Irish reunification spark controversy and reignite debate over a referendum, with unionists expressing concern about threats to the United Kingdom.

en.title: Trump, a united Ireland would be fantastic
en.summary: The U.S. president expresses a positive view regarding the prospect of Irish reunification.

stories.title: Stress emergente, l’Aidp in prima linea

en.title: Emerging stress, Aidp in the front line
en.summary: Aidp is addressing the issue of return-to-work stress, which remains under-explored in established workplace practices but is widely felt in companies. The organization has begun developing solutions to tackle this concern.

stories.title: Alberto Fassi: «Per fare impresa, non smettere mai di sognare»

en.title: Alberto Fassi: "To do business, never stop dreaming"
en.summary: Legami founder Alberto Fassi discusses his entrepreneurial vision and two special projects: the Dreamland natural park and the book "We are dreamers."

stories.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: piano governativo a fasi per gestire lo stop all’area a caldo e le ripercussioni occupazionali

en.title: Ex Ilva Taranto: government plan in phases to manage the hot area shutdown and employment repercussions
en.summary: Following a Milan Court of Appeal order issued on September 11, the hot section of the former Ilva steel plant in Taranto must cease operations by end of October, prompting a phased government management plan for the shutdown and its employment consequences.

en.title: Production advancing slowly in Lombardy
en.summary: Lombardy's economy showed industrial production growth of 0.1% on a quarterly basis in the second trimester, marking the sixth consecutive advance in an ongoing recovery.

stories.title: Presentato in Usa supermagnete italiano ad alta temperatura

en.title: Italian high-temperature supermagnent presented in USA
en.summary: An Italian high-technology supermagnent was presented in Pittsburgh by Lucio Rossi, project leader of the National Institute of Nuclear Physics, led by Antonio Zoccoli.
